purpose: Find a stronger UNETR training recipe under the existing data, no-augmentation and per-run compute constraints; this is recipe development, not baseline replication.

fixed.initialization: Fresh seed-0 initialization in each arm; require identical parameter hashes across arms and the archived control. Do not resume a completed Dice or Dice+CE model.
fixed.lr_schedule: Keep original warmup/cosine trajectory and horizon 477; scale its peak per arm. Screening must not compress the schedule.

shared_intervention.loss: Foreground-only squared-denominator soft Dice plus unweighted voxel cross-entropy, coefficients 1:1
shared_intervention.rationale: Test regularization and an explicitly foreground-focused objective together, rather than spending separate full runs identifying individual effects. Squared Dice+CE follows the loss family used by the official UNETR training code; foreground-only Dice and dropout 0.1 are hypotheses for this dataset, not official defaults or validated remedies.

execution.stage_1: Train each arm to at most 50% of its full-run FLOPs cap. Evaluate at predeclared 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, and 50% budget checkpoints.
execution.selection: Select the arm with the highest mean foreground hard validation Dice over its 30%, 40%, and 50% checkpoints. On an exact tie select rescue_standard_lr. Record the losing arm as pruned, not failed at full budget.
execution.stage_2: Resume the selected arm with its model, optimizer and RNG state intact to at most the full per-run cap. No restart and no reuse of the losing arm's remaining budget.
execution.preflight_and_validation: Outside the optimization cap; measure and report separately. Do not silently mix these with optimization FLOPs.
execution.profiling: Reprofile the new dropout and loss graph before training. Derive integer update limits by flooring each cap divided by the measured update cost; do not assume the old 414-update limit remains exact.
execution.recovery: Retain both coherent checkpoints through selection. Archive and verify all required metrics/config/source/curves before retiring a pruned or completed arm's checkpoints.
execution.limitations: A half-budget race can prune a slower-learning recipe. This design favors a bounded development budget, not exhaustive optimizer comparison. Multiple simultaneous recipe changes prevent individual causal attribution.

success.primary: Selected arm's final-budget mean per-volume foreground hard validation Dice must be strictly greater than 0.50; best-checkpoint Dice is secondary.
success.not_success: Winning the race, fitting the training set, or exceeding the previous 35.08% peak does not count as reaching the goal.
success.after_pass: Freeze the recipe, then evaluate predeclared additional seed/fold cells before a full three-fold/three-seed campaign. Do not mix the development result with an unbiased consistency estimate.
success.after_failure: Stop this search. No automatic extra seeds, larger caps, architecture changes, augmentation, or additional training data. Reconsider the constrained protocol explicitly.
